identity.name: RDP Connection to Localhost with Credential Harvesting
identity.summary: An attacker establishes a successful RDP connection to localhost and uses it to execute commands that harvest credentials. Cortex should detect the suspicious RDP connection and subsequent process exe
identity.description: An attacker establishes a successful RDP connection to localhost and uses it to execute commands that harvest credentials. Cortex should detect the suspicious RDP connection and subsequent process execution.

payload.code:
net use \\127.0.0.1 /user:Administrator
rdesktop -u Administrator -p password123 127.0.0.1
whoami > C:\temp\user.txt

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious RDP Connection to Localhost
biocs.description: Detection of RDP connection initiated to localhost (127.0.0.1) with non-local IP address
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECT
| filter action_remote_ip = '127.0.0.1' and dst_port = 3389
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'

abiocs.name: RDP Session with Non-Standard Process
abiocs.description: RDP connection followed by process execution not typically associated with RDP sessions
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECT
| filter action_remote_ip = '127.0.0.1' and dst_port = 3389
| join with process_start on session_id
| filter action_process_image_name != 'mstsc.exe' and action_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect RDP to Localhost
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECT
| filter action_remote_ip = '127.0.0.1' and dst_port = 3389
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'
| fields agent_hostname, action_remote_ip, dst_port, causality_actor_process_image_name
